title.zh: 三星钱包与 Sui 合作，为美国 Galaxy 用户提供 USDC 转账
title.en: Samsung Wallet partners with Sui to enable USDC transfers for US Galaxy users

current_state.zh: Sui announced a partnership with Samsung Wallet to enable gas-free USDC holding and transfers for Galaxy device users in the US, with SUI itself not supported and plans to expand to other markets.
current_state.en: Sui announced a partnership with Samsung Wallet to enable gas-free USDC holding and transfers for Galaxy device users in the US, with SUI itself not supported and plans to expand to other markets.

updates.title_zh: 【三星钱包与 Sui 达成合作，支持 Sui 上 USDC 转账】
updates.title_en: 【三星钱包与 Sui 达成合作，支持 Sui 上 USDC 转账】
updates.what_changed_zh: Sui and Samsung Wallet partnered to enable gasless USDC transfers on Sui for Galaxy device users in the US, with only USDC supported initially and no support for the SUI token.
updates.what_changed_en: Sui and Samsung Wallet partnered to enable gasless USDC transfers on Sui for Galaxy device users in the US, with only USDC supported initially and no support for the SUI token.
